title: Quickly create PBR materials for your game, what do you think?
author: Super_Golf_1404
selftext:
Hi everyone, we've been working on a webtool (pbrgen.com) that generates seamless PBR materials that you can use in your games. Yeah, another one, but we really focused on creating something that makes the AI more steerable, and feel less like a slot machine.



I've created a video that goes over the process of creating a material, and any feedback is greatly appreciated.



Also if you don't want to open the tool (and the video is too long - guilty) shout something you want me to make in the comments and I'll paste a shareable link to that material so you can download all the maps.



Flip

comments.author: will75g
comments.body:
It looks good, but the 2K limit is a deal breaker for me.

Also, would this be useful with photogrammetry materials? With ArtEngine gone, there's need for a tool that can delight, remove seams and generate roughness and other maps.

replies.author: Super_Golf_1404
replies.body:
Thanks for commenting + feedback!, we will bring back 4K support in the future, but need to update some stuff on the backend for that. We are also getting a delight model on there (first results are really promising when removing shadows and lighting). I expect that one pretty soon. I wasn't familiar with ArtEngine, but I'll have a look. 

Technically it's already possible to delight, but I think from quickly peaking it's not yet at the realism you want. Anyhow If you throw me an image I am more then happy to run it through the tool and post the result here
